mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.normalized_dish_name, r.display_dish_name, r.dish_unit, r.category, r.normalized_ingredient_name, r.display_ingredient_name, r.ingredient_quantity, r.ingredient_unit, r.price_reference_unit, r.note, p.lowest_price AS reference_price, p.source AS price_source, p.observed_at AS price_observed_at FROM FEED_DISH_RECIPE_INGREDIENT r LEFT JOIN FEED_PRICE_REFERENCE p ON p.normalized_item_name = r.normalized_ingredient_name AND p.brand = '' AND REPLACE(LOWER(p.unit), ' ', '') = REPLACE(LOWER(r.price_reference_unit), ' ', '') WHERE r.category = #{category} AND REPLACE(LOWER(r.dish_unit), ' ', '') = #{normalizedDishUnit} AND r.normalized_dish_name = ( SELECT r2.normalized_dish_name FROM FEED_DISH_RECIPE_INGREDIENT r2 WHERE r2.category = #{category} AND REPLACE(LOWER(r2.dish_unit), ' ', '') = #{normalizedDishUnit} AND ( r2.normalized_dish_name = #{normalizedDishName} OR r2.normalized_dish_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{normalizedDishName}, '%') OR #{normalizedDishName} LIKE CONCAT('%', r2.normalized_dish_name, '%') ) GROUP BY r2.normalized_dish_name ORDER BY r2.normalized_dish_name = #{normalizedDishName} DESC, CHAR_LENGTH(r2.normalized_dish_name) DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY r.id
